interaction_rendering.bridge: Original river-cascade and timber-crossing restored. Deck region y0..360, crossbeams y360..430, timber-only pile region y440..540. Final crossbeam/pile shifts 14 world pixels toward waterfall current to avoid rock. Original UV samples occlude feet. Contact remains subject to visual review. interaction_rendering.terrain: Root footprints reject raised obstacles and unsupported/edge positions. Scenery and foreground roots share world/camera transforms; render-clock parallax correction retained.
